# Yebis Engineering — GRADE 3 General Contractor (GC-3)

> From Structure to Finish. Turnkey building execution, specialized MEP engineering, interior fit-outs, and civil contracting across Addis Ababa and Ethiopia.

## Company Overview

Yebis Engineering (Yeshitila Tedla & Brook Yeshitila General Partnership) is a licensed GRADE 3 Ethiopian General Contractor based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Formerly operating as Yeshitila Tedla Building Contractor, the firm has delivered over 19 major public, commercial, and institutional construction contracts spanning 100M+ ETB in cumulative project value.

- **License Tier:** GRADE 3 General Contractor (GC-3)
- **Trade Registration:** BL/AA/1/0001088/2004
- **Tax Identification Number (TIN):** 0001985917
- **Headquarters:** Bole Road, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
- **Website:** https://yebisengineering.pro.et

## Core Capabilities

- **Structural Engineering & Shell Construction:** Deep foundation systems, suspended reinforced concrete frames, post-tensioned slabs, and structural steel framing.
- **MEP Engineering & Systems:** Comprehensive electrical distribution, sub-station tie-ins, backup generators, plumbing, sanitary networks, and HVAC.
- **Interior Finishing & Millwork:** Architectural suspended ceilings, bespoke joinery, custom furniture fabrication, drywall partitioning, and tiling.
- **Metal & Aluminum Facades:** Structural curtain walls, thermally broken aluminum fenestration, composite panels, and security metalworks.
- **Building Renovation & Maintenance:** Facility retrofits, structural rehabilitations, adaptive reuse, and facility upkeep.
- **BIM Coordination & Virtual Construction:** Clashing detection, 3D architectural coordination, quantity takeoffs, and construction sequencing.

## Major Project Sectors & Track Record

- **Higher Education & Vocational Colleges:** TVET campus expansions, workshop halls with industrial clearances, lecture halls, and compound infrastructure (e.g., Chole TVET College Campus Expansion).
- **Public & Municipal Trade Infrastructure:** Regional livestock trade centers, administrative facilities, sanitary installations (e.g., Woliso Secondary Livestock Market Center).
- **Commercial & Office Developments:** Multi-story office towers, corporate headquarters, high-end retail fit-outs in Kazanchis and Bole, Addis Ababa.
- **Healthcare & Specialized Facilities:** Clinical wings, diagnostic laboratories, cleanroom finishes, and medical infrastructure.
